subject: Campaign finance: advertising
bill.title: Campaign finance: advertising; transparency requirements for paid political advertisements; provide for. Amends sec. 15 of 1976 PA 388 (MCL 169.215) & adds sec. 59a.

action.description: introduced by Representative Rep. Reggie Miller

posted_text:
💰 Elections & Voting Rights
MI HB 6439 — Michigan Wants to Make Campaign Ads Easier to Track

Representative Reggie Miller’s bill aims to make tracking political advertising in Michigan simpler. It directs the Secretary of State to create a system for filing and organizing campaign finance reports, including a coding system and manuals for county clerks. ...
